known.via: English Wikipedia "Morellino di Scansano" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: A red DOCG from the hills around Scansano in the Maremma, coastal Tuscany, made from at least 85% Sangiovese, which is called Morellino locally. It became DOC in 1978 and DOCG from the 2007 vintage.
